from openpyxl import load_workbook
from pathlib import Path

input_path = Path("/mnt/data/spreadsheet/587-38/1_587-38_input.xlsx")
output_path = Path("/mnt/data/outputs/587-38_0_fa0eed04/1_587-38_output.xlsx")

ws2 = wb["Sheet2"]

# Build the expanded result: repeat OrderTypeSAP and Name for the number of
# material cells indicated by the count in column K.
result_rows = []
for r in range(2, ws1.max_row + 1):
    order_type = ws1.cell(r, 1).value   # Column A
    name = ws1.cell(r, 2).value         # Column B
    count_val = ws1.cell(r, 11).value   # Column K
    if order_type is None and name is None:
        continue
    try:
        n = int(count_val)
    except (TypeError, ValueError):
        n = 0

    for i in range(n):
        material = ws1.cell(r, 3 + i).value  # Materials start in column C
        result_rows.append([order_type, name, material])

# Only modify the allowed answer range: Sheet2!G1:I12.
for row in range(1, 13):
    for col in range(7, 10):  # G:I
        ws2.cell(row, col).value = None

for idx, values in enumerate(result_rows[:12], start=1):
    for offset, value in enumerate(values):
        ws2.cell(idx, 7 + offset).value = value

wb.save(output_path)
